baby-hungry.observed_description: The family baby in the pale-yellow romper cries in a white high chair, reaching toward an empty bowl and spoon on the tray in a bright kitchen; hungry reads at every size and in the 4:5 crop; no text.

grandfather-tired.observed_description: The yawn reads well, but the book on the side table carries a crisp pseudo-title and a publisher logo that stay readable at 900 px; a redo keeps the side table to a mug only.

girl-sad.observed_description: The girl in the lilac T-shirt sits alone on a stone garden step with her chin in her hands, mouth turned down and eyes lowered; sad reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no text.

children-happy.observed_description: The boy and the girl laugh with open mouths and raised fists in the sunny garden; happy reads at every size; the 4:5 crop keeps both faces; no text.

mother-thirsty.observed_description: The mother in the rust-red blouse wipes her forehead after gardening and reaches for a tall glass of iced water beside a full jug on the kitchen counter, mouth open; thirsty reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no text.

children-lets-play.observed_description: The boy holds a worn soccer ball under one arm and turns to the girl with an open hand toward the lawn, inviting her; she smiles back; he is clearly the speaker at every size; no text on the ball.

ana-lets-watch-tv.observed_description: Ana and Luis sit on a grey sofa facing a TV whose screen shows only warm blurred colors; Ana holds the remote toward it and smiles at Luis, who listens; she is the speaker; no text or logos.

grandparents-lets-listen.observed_description: The grandmother holds a plain wooden box that does not read as a radio or as music at any size; a redo shows a record player and headphones.

review-grandmother-happy.observed_description: The grandmother in her cream cardigan laughs with a big open smile, holding a bouquet of yellow and orange flowers in a sunny garden; happy reads at every size and in the 4:5 crop; no text.

review-boy-thirsty.observed_description: The boy in the blue polo drinks eagerly from an unlabeled water bottle on a dry park field with a soccer ball under his arm, a little sweaty; thirsty reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no text.

review-red-hat.observed_description: A smiling woman with long black hair in a bright red knitted hat and a grey coat on a frosty town sidewalk; the red hat is large and obvious at every size and in the 4:5 crop; background signs are unreadable blur.

review-lets-read.observed_description: At a sunny cafe table a woman with short grey hair holds open a picture book of colorful abstract drawings and gestures to a bearded man who leans in smiling; she is the speaker; the page edge shows no readable text at runtime sizes.

review-cold-hat.observed_description: A man in a black winter coat pulls a thick grey wool hat down over his ears on a snowy street, snow falling and his breath visible; cold reads at every size and in the 4:5 crop; shop signs are blank.

review-does-not-understand.observed_description: At a station ticket window a man in a grey jacket frowns with his head tilted and both palms up while a clerk behind the glass explains; not understanding reads at 180 px; the man stays whole in the 4:5 crop; no readable signs.

luis-ok.observed_description: Same sofa, TV, room and light as Ana's invitation: Luis now smiles at Ana and gives a clear thumbs up while she smiles back holding the remote; agreeing reads at 180 px; the 4:5 crop trims his face, so the card keeps it out of four-picture grids.

grandfather-tired-2.observed_description: The grandfather yawns widely with eyes closed and both hands raised to his mouth in his armchair under a warm lamp; the side table holds only a plain mug; shelf spines behind are soft and unreadable; tired reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop.

grandparents-lets-listen-2.observed_description: On the patterned sofa the grandmother hands a pair of large headphones to the smiling grandfather beside an open record player with a plain black record and a plain red label; music reads at every size; the 4:5 crop keeps the headphones and both faces; no text.
